meta.name: zena-expression-lexicon
meta.semantic: Raon Zena expression dictionary. Every node uses the Qntology/logis-center bias.json node format (semantic, bias, prejudice, exact_match): bias and prejudice are comma-separated multilingual phrase lists, exact_match confirms a node before any vector is computed (exact or agglutinative prefix match). Zena-specific fields say how the character expresses the node: express (emotion, motion, lines), command (manage_zena_system), ask (hand the request to Raon-1-nano). The vision group follows noto-sandbox's world_lexicon: English prompts for the Raon-VisionEncoder (SigLIP2) text tower, prompt-ensembled with vision_prompting.templates, each linked to the expression node the character plays when the screen shows it.

request.semantic: Request endings and politeness markers. They carry no expression domain of their own, so a span made only of them never wins.
request.bias: 해 줘, 해줘, 줘, 주세요, 줄래, 해 줄래, 부탁해, 좀, 할래, 하자, 알려 줘, 보여 줘, 봐, 봐 줘, 해 봐, please, could you, can you, would you, let's

filler.semantic: Conversational fillers and intensifiers that do not name anything.
filler.bias: 음, 어, 아, 그, 저기, 그냥, 막, 진짜, 완전, 약간, 너무, 되게, 지금, 방금, 오늘, um, uh, like, just, so, really

exit_app.semantic: The user wants the Zena application to quit (not just hide).
exit_app.bias: 종료해 줘, 앱 꺼 줘, 프로그램 종료, 오늘 그만 켜둘게, 이제 꺼도 돼, 제나 꺼, quit the app, exit, close zena
exit_app.prejudice: 숨어 있어, 게임 종료됐어, 창 뒤로 가, 잘 자

hide_avatar.semantic: The user wants Zena hidden for a while, the app keeps running.
hide_avatar.bias: 잠깐 숨어 있어, 모습 숨겨 줘, 안 보이게 해 줘, 잠깐 사라져, hide yourself

show_avatar.semantic: The user wants a hidden Zena to come back.
show_avatar.bias: 다시 나와, 다시 보여 줘, 돌아와, 모습 보여 줘, show yourself

topmost_on.semantic: Keep the Zena window above every other window.
topmost_on.bias: 화면 맨 앞으로 나와, 항상 위에 떠 있어, 제일 앞에 있어, always on top
topmost_on.prejudice: 다른 창 뒤로 가, 다시 나와

topmost_off.semantic: Let other windows cover the Zena window.
topmost_off.bias: 다른 창 뒤로 가 있어, 창 뒤로 가, 뒤에 가 있어, go behind other windows
topmost_off.prejudice: 화면 맨 앞으로 나와, 숨어 있어

interactive_mode.semantic: The user wants to drag or click Zena (the window takes mouse input).
interactive_mode.bias: 위치 옮길게, 너 좀 움직일게, 드래그할게, let me move you

ghost_mode.semantic: Clicks must pass through Zena to the game (combat mode).
ghost_mode.bias: 클릭 통과시켜 줘, 전투 모드로 해, 클릭 안 걸리게, click through

celebrate.semantic: The user won, cleared, succeeded or got a rare drop and is happy about it.
celebrate.bias: 이겼다, 이겼어, 클리어했다, 성공했다, 해냈다, 보스 잡았어, 득템했다, 대박이다, 레벨 업했어, 랭크 올랐어, 1등 했어, we won, i did it, victory, nailed it, level up
celebrate.prejudice: 졌다, 실패했어, 또 죽었어, 망했다, 주식 올랐어

frustrated.semantic: The user lost, died or failed and is frustrated or annoyed.
frustrated.bias: 또 죽었어, 졌다, 망했다, 짜증 나, 열받아, 왜 안 돼, 너무 어려워, 실패했어, 게임 오버, 억울해, i died again, we lost, this is so hard, so annoying

lines: 패턴 거의 다 봤어, 한 번만 더!

praise.bias: 잘했어 제나, 똑똑하다, 최고야, 귀여워, 멋지다, 역시 제나, good job, you are the best, so cute

thanks.bias: 고마워, 고맙다, 땡큐, 감사해, 덕분이야, thanks, thank you

surprised.semantic: The user is startled or shocked by something that just happened.
surprised.bias: 헐, 깜짝이야, 뭐야 이거, 말도 안 돼, 이게 뭐야, 실화냐, whoa, what the, no way

scared.semantic: The user is scared (horror game, dark place).
scared.bias: 무서워, 소름 돋아, 귀신 나와, 공포 게임, 너무 어두워, scary, i am scared, creepy

tired.semantic: The user is tired, sleepy or worn out.
tired.bias: 피곤해, 졸려, 힘들다, 지쳤어, 눈 아파, 오래 했다, so tired, sleepy, exhausted

sad.semantic: The user is sad or feeling down.
sad.bias: 슬퍼, 우울해, 속상해, 눈물 나, 기운 없어, i am sad, feeling down

greeting.semantic: The user says hello or announces they are back.
greeting.bias: 안녕, 하이, 좋은 아침, 반가워, 나 왔어, 오랜만이야, hello, hi, good morning
greeting.prejudice: 잘 자, 다음에 봐, 종료해 줘

farewell.semantic: The user says goodbye for now (the app keeps running unless they ask to quit).
farewell.bias: 잘 자, 다음에 봐, 나 갈게, 이따 봐, 바이바이, good night, bye, see you
farewell.prejudice: 종료해 줘, 앱 꺼 줘, 안녕 반가워

cheer_me.semantic: The user asks Zena to cheer them on or to focus together.
cheer_me.bias: 응원해 줘, 파이팅, 힘내자, 집중하자, 할 수 있겠지, cheer me on, let's go

bored.semantic: The user is bored and wants something to do.
bored.bias: 심심해, 지루해, 할 거 없어, 노잼, i am bored

lines: 음… 오늘은 다른 캐릭터 해 볼까?

stock_up.semantic: The user's stock or coin went up, or they took profit (Korean charts show gains in red).
stock_up.bias: 주식 올랐어, 떡상, 익절했어, 수익 났어, 빨간불이야, 상한가, 코인 올랐어, my stock went up, took profit, to the moon

stock_down.semantic: The user's stock or coin went down or they cut a loss (Korean charts show losses in blue).
stock_down.bias: 주식 떨어졌어, 떡락, 손절했어, 물렸어, 파란불이야, 하한가, 마이너스야, 코인 떨어졌어, my stock dropped, i lost money

lines: 한 번 숨 고르고 다시 보자.

ask_market.semantic: The user asks about the market or a chart (Zena talks it over but never gives investment advice).
ask_market.bias: 이 차트 어때, 지금 사야 돼, 팔아야 돼, 주식 어떻게 생각해, should i buy, what about this chart

game_tip.semantic: The user asks how to beat, dodge or progress in the game.
game_tip.bias: 보스 패턴 어떻게 피해, 이거 어떻게 잡아, 공략 알려 줘, 지금 뭐 해야 돼, 어디로 가야 돼, how do i dodge this, any tips
game_tip.prejudice: 인벤토리에서 물약 어디 있어, 응원해 줘

inventory.semantic: The user asks where an item is or how many are left.
inventory.bias: 인벤토리에서 물약 어디 있어, 가방에 아이템 어디 있어, 포션 몇 개 남았어, where is my potion

what_is_this.semantic: The user asks Zena about what is on the screen right now; the answer uses the latest screen domain the watcher saw.
what_is_this.bias: 이거 뭐야, 화면 봐 봐, 이거 봐 봐, 뭐 보여, 지금 뭐 하는 것 같아, what is this, look at my screen
what_is_this.prejudice: 뭐야 이거 깜짝이야, 인벤토리에서 물약 어디 있어

small_talk.semantic: Open small talk addressed to Zena; Raon-1-nano answers.
small_talk.bias: 기분 어때, 뭐 하고 있었어, 오늘 어땠어, 이야기하자, 너는 뭐 좋아해, how are you, what are you doing
small_talk.prejudice: 보스 패턴 어떻게 피해, 종료해 줘

robot_mode.semantic: The user asks Zena to transform into her parametric robot / toy body (Track A, SolidCraft).
robot_mode.bias: 로봇 모드, 로봇으로 변신, 로봇 제나, 메카 모드, 로봇 변신, robot mode, transform into a robot

anime_2d.semantic: The user asks for Zena's 2D anime look (Track B-1, layered SD parts).
anime_2d.bias: 2D 모드, 애니 모드, 일러스트 모드, 2D로 바꿔, 2d mode, anime mode

anime_3d.semantic: The user asks for Zena's 3D anime model (Track B-2, VRM).
anime_3d.bias: 3D 모드, VRM 모드, 입체 모드, 3D로 바꿔, 3d mode, vrm mode

default_look.semantic: The user wants Zena's default look back.
default_look.bias: 원래대로, 원래 모습, 기본 모습, 기본 모드, 처음 모습, default look, back to normal

glasses.semantic: The user asks Zena to put on glasses.
glasses.bias: 안경 써 봐, 안경 껴 봐, 안경 써, 안경 착용, put on glasses, wear glasses

headset.semantic: The user asks Zena to put on a headset.
headset.bias: 헤드셋 써 봐, 헤드폰 써 봐, 헤드셋 착용, put on a headset, wear headphones

cat_ears.semantic: The user asks Zena to wear cat ears.
cat_ears.bias: 고양이 귀, 냥이 귀, 고양이 귀 달아 봐, cat ears

ribbon.semantic: The user asks Zena to wear a ribbon.
ribbon.bias: 리본 달아 봐, 리본 해 봐, 리본, ribbon, wear a bow

take_off.semantic: The user asks Zena to take her accessories off.
take_off.bias: 다 벗어, 벗어 봐, 액세서리 빼 줘, 장식 빼, 다 빼, take it off, remove accessories

idle.semantic: Said on her own after a long silence on a screen she has no line for.

combat.semantic: A quiet moment during a fight.

menu.semantic: The player has been sitting in a game menu.

lines: 로딩 길다~ 어깨 한 번 돌려 볼까?

market.semantic: The player has been watching charts for a while.

lines: 차트만 보면 눈 아파. 잠깐 쉬자!

video.semantic: The player is watching a video.

coding.semantic: The player has been coding quietly.

lines: 막히면 나한테 설명해 봐. 말하다 보면 풀려!

work.semantic: The player has been working on a document.

lines: 잘하고 있어. 물 한 잔 어때?

coach.semantic: Said on her own when the course section turns high-friction (the player keeps failing here): a short coaching line before the full silence.

lines: 여기 좀 막히지? 패턴 한 번 같이 보자!
천천히! 첫 공격만 피하면 길이 보여.
숨 한 번 고르고 다시 가 보자. 할 수 있어!

stretch.semantic: The same screen for a long session: suggest a break.

lines: 벌써 한참 했어! 같이 스트레칭 하자~
눈 좀 쉬어 주자. 먼 곳 한 번 보기!

combat.semantic: Screen-only reaction: a fight is on screen. Zena focuses silently; the event sensor drives the Lv1-Lv3 combat reactions.

menu.semantic: Screen-only reaction: a game menu, lobby or inventory screen.

loading.semantic: Screen-only reaction: a loading screen; a good moment for a short break line.

market.semantic: Screen-only reaction: a price chart or trading app is open.

video.semantic: Screen-only reaction: a video or stream is playing.

coding.semantic: Screen-only reaction: code editor or terminal.

work.semantic: Screen-only reaction: documents, spreadsheets, slides or web pages.

privacy.semantic: Screen-only reaction to a private screen (login, banking, payment, personal chat): Zena looks away and says nothing, and the watcher backs off.

vision_prompting.semantic: Prompt ensembling for the SigLIP2 text tower (noto-sandbox world_lexicon): every vision phrase is embedded once per template and the unit mean is its anchor. Background phrases are never subtracted as prejudice.

game_combat.semantic: A fight in a video game.
game_combat.bias: a video game battle with monsters, an action game fight with spell effects, an rpg boss fight, a first person shooter game, a fantasy game character attacking enemies
game_combat.prejudice: a stock market chart, a spreadsheet, source code in an editor, a computer desktop

game_victory.bias: a victory screen in a video game, a level complete screen, the word victory in large letters, a winning screen with a trophy
game_victory.prejudice: a game over screen, a defeat screen

game_defeat.semantic: A game over or defeat screen.
game_defeat.bias: a game over screen, a defeat screen in a video game, the words you died in red letters, a red defeat banner
game_defeat.prejudice: a victory screen, a level complete screen

game_menu.semantic: A game menu, lobby, character select or inventory screen.
game_menu.bias: a video game main menu, a character selection screen, a game inventory screen with item slots, a game lobby
game_menu.prejudice: a video game battle with monsters, a loading screen

loading.bias: a loading screen with a progress bar, a game loading screen with tips, a spinning loading icon

stock_chart.semantic: A stock, coin or other price chart, or a trading app.
stock_chart.bias: a stock price candlestick chart, a stock trading app, a financial chart with price lines, a cryptocurrency exchange chart
stock_chart.prejudice: a video game, source code in an editor, a spreadsheet

video.semantic: A video player, movie or live stream.
video.bias: a video player playing a movie, a youtube video, a live stream with a chat, an anime episode
video.prejudice: a video game battle with monsters

coding.semantic: A code editor, IDE or terminal.
coding.bias: source code in a code editor, a programming ide with syntax highlighting, a terminal window with commands

document.semantic: A document, spreadsheet, slide deck or article page.
document.bias: a text document, a spreadsheet with tables, a web page article, a presentation slide
document.prejudice: source code in a code editor, a stock price candlestick chart

private.semantic: A private screen: login, password, banking, payment or a personal chat. Nothing is said about it and the watcher backs off.
private.bias: a login page with a password field, an online banking page, a payment form with a credit card number, a messenger chat with personal messages
